title: RADIO FM-SPEAKERS & CAPACITORS
summary: RPO U69 AM/FM radio: the two dash speakers (LH and RH), mounted face-up under the instrument panel upper pad in production speaker housings, and the radio-noise suppression capacitors under the dash (at the directional signal flasher, at the ignition switch and taped to the instrument panel harness near the brake pedal/stop lamp switch). Each speaker is held by nuts on production screws through its flange (7-22 LBS IN listed on the sheet); speaker leads are taped and plug into the harness.
